steps.headline: 1. Voice vocabulary gets its own Settings entry below Sound.
steps.changed: A new Voice vocabulary row opens the editor for names, words and phrases.
steps.notice: You can find your speech hints without opening model or assistant settings.
steps.risk: This first version is desktop-only. The phone uses a different speech recognizer.

steps.headline: 2. Add and save your vocabulary.
steps.changed: One phrase per line; delete lines to remove hints.
steps.notice: Local hints for your next recording, not forced replacements.
